arabic text: KARBALA ZINDA RAHEGI ZINDA RAHENGE MATAMI
english translation text: KARBALA WILL REMAIN ALIVE, THE ‘MATAMIS’ WILL FOREVER REMAIN ALIVE

arabic text: KARBAL KI KAHAANI JAB KOI BHI SUNAYEGA\nPARDA E GHAYBAT ME JAB TAK\nHAI IMAM E AAKHRI
english translation text: WHENEVER THE STORY OF KARBALA IS NARRATED\nAS LONG AS THE FINAL IMAM IS IN OCCULTATION

arabic text:
KARBALA MOJIZ NUMA HAI, MATAMI HAI MOJIZA
EK AZADARI KA MARKAZ, EK MUJASSAM HAI AZA
SAAIBAAN DONO PE HAR DAM, BIBI ZAHRA KI DUA
JAB TALAK BAQI HAI DUNYA, AUR USKE BAAD BHI
english translation text:
KARBALA IS A MIRACLE, AND MATAMIS ARE THE MANIFESTATION OF THIS MIRACLE
ONE IS THE CENTRE FOR AZADARI, ONE IS AZADARI PERSONIFIED
THE PRAYERS OF BIBI FATIMA (AS) WILL FOREVER PROTECT THE AZADARS
AS LONG AS THIS WORLD REMAINS
AND EVEN THEREAFTER

arabic text:
ISHQ E SHAHE DEEN KA YEH, SILSILA SADIYON SE HAI
MATAMI SADIYON SE HAIN AUR, KARBALA SADIYON SE HAI
KARBALA SE MATAMI KA, RAABTA SADIYON SE HAI
ROK NA PAAEGI MEHSHAR, TAK ISSE DUNYA KABHI
english translation text:
THE LOVE FOR THE KING OF THE RELIGION HAS EXISTED THROUGH THE CENTURIES
MATAMIS HAVE EXISTED FOR CENTURIES,
KARBALA HAS EXISTED THROUGH CENTURIES
THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN MATAMIS AND KARBALA, HAS EXISTED THROUGH CENTURIES
THIS WORLD WILL NOT BE ABLE TO STOP THIS TILL THE DAY OF RECKONING

arabic text:
KARBALA KI KHAAK ME SHAAMIL HUWI KHAAKE SHIFA
MATAMI KI KHAAK ME SHAAMIL HAI KHAAKE KARBALA
KHAAK HOJAEGA SAB KUCH, YEH NAHI HONGE FANA
BA KHUDA ZAMIN BANE HAI, INKE KHUD AALE NABI
english translation text:
THE DUST OF CURE WAS MIXED WITH THE DUST OF KARBALA
THE DUST OF KARBALA WAS MIXED WITH THE CLAY OF THE MATAMIS
THIS WORLD WILL BE REDUCED TO DUST, BUT THEY (MATAMIS & KARBALA) WILL NEVER BE DESTROYED
BY GOD, THEY ARE PROTECTED BY THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET!

arabic text:
SAARI DUNYA KI ZAMEENO ME HAI AFZAL KARBALA
SAARE INSAANO ME AFZAL BA KHUDA EHLE AZA
AB TAQABUL INSE DUNYA ME KISI KA KYA BHALA
KARBALA TO KARBALA HA, MATAMI HAI MATAMI
KARBALA IS KARBALA
english translation text:
THE LAND OF KARBALA IS THE THE HIGHEST AMONGST ALL LANDS
BY GOD, THE PEOPLE OF HUSSAIN ARE HIGHER THAN THE REST
HOW CAN WE COMPARE THESE TO ANYTHING ELSE IN THE WORLD?
MATAMIS ARE MATAMIS

arabic text:
KARBALA ME HAR GHARI MOWJOOD JAISE MATAMI
MATAMI KE DIL ME AISE KARBALA HAI HAR GHARI
WASF DONO KE JUDA HAI, PAR HAI DONO EK HI
YEH AZADARI SE SHEH KI, NA JUDA HONGE KABHI
english translation text:
JUST AS MATAMIS ARE ALWAYS IN KARBALA
KARBALA IS ALWAYS IN THE HEART OF A MATAMI
THEY HAVE DIFFERENT CHARACTERISTICS, BUT THEY ARE TRULY ONE
THEY SHALL NEVER BE SEPARATED FROM THE AZADARI OF IMAM HUSSAIN

arabic text:
KARBALA ME FATIMA ZAHRA KA GHAR LUTA GAYA
IS LIYE SAB MATAMI KARTE HAI YEH MATAM BAPA
KAT GAYE GHAZI KE BAZU
KHOON ME AKBAR KE GESU
HOGAYE QASIM KE TUKDE
english translation text:
THE HOUSE OF FATIMA (AS) WAS DESTROYED IN KARBALA
HENCE THE MATAMIS MOURN AND LAMENT IN KARBALA
THE ARMS OF ABBAS WERE SEVERED
AKBAR’S HAIR WAS FULL OF BLOOD
QASIM’S BODY WAS IN PIECES

arabic text:
KHOON ME ASGHER HAIN DOOBE
NA RAHE HAYE SHAAHE ALAM
KARSAKI ZAINAB NA MATAM
KYUN NA HO MATAM BAPA
JAB TALAK SAANSE CHALENGI, HOGA YE MATAM YUHI
english translation text:
ASGHAR DROWNED IN BLOOD
THE KING OF THE WORLD DIDN’T REMAIN
ZAINAB WAS NOT ABLE TO LAMENT
WHY SHOULD WE NOT LAMENT
UNTIL OUR LAST BREATH
WE WILL DO MATAM

arabic text:
HAR GHARI SALMAN IS PER SHUKR KA SAJDA KIYA
KARBALAI BHI HAIN HUM AUR MATAMI BHI BA KHUDA
KYUN KARIM IS PER KAREIN NA FAKHR HUM EHLE AZA
MATAM E SARWAR MILA AUR, KARBALA HUMKO MILI
english translation text:
EVERY MOMENT, SALMAN, WE PROSTRATED IN THANKFULNESS
BY GOD, WE ARE KARBALAI, AND WE ARE MATAMI
WHY SHOULD WE NOT, KARIM, BE PROUD OF THIS
WE WERE BLESSED WITH THE MATAM OF IMAM HUSSAIN
WE WERE BLESSED WITH KARBALA
